data.name: Molesweeper
data.detailed_description:
DIG. SEARCH. ESCAPE.

Take control of a fearless mole and dig deep underground in a strategic arcade challenge. Somewhere beneath the soil lies a hidden bomb — your goal is to locate it before time runs out.

But digging blindly is dangerous.

Every tunnel you create becomes a path that rising water can flood, cutting off your escape and forcing you to think carefully about every move.

FIND THE HIDDEN BOMB

Each level hides a bomb somewhere underground. Explore the terrain, dig smart tunnels, and locate it before the clock reaches zero.

WATCH THE WATER

The deeper you go, the more dangerous the underground becomes. Rising water will flood the tunnels you create, limiting your movement and forcing you to plan your route carefully.

USE SPECIAL ABILITIES

Collect ability pickups during your run and activate them at the right moment to escape danger or improve your search.

UNLOCK NEW MOLES

Discover new moles with unique abilities and experiment with different strategies.

COMPETE FOR THE BEST RUN

Climb the global leaderboard and prove who can dig the smartest.

How deep can you go before the tunnels flood?
